meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器 agent 调用本地 AI 模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器中通过 OpenAI 兼容接口调用本地模型。
copy.tagline_en: Enable container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to call local models from a container via OpenAI-compatible API.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 新增两个工具:列出 Atomic Chat 桌面板中已加载的模型、把提示词发给指定模型并取回回复。Claude 仍负责统筹,可把部分任务交给运行在本地的 Atomic Chat 模型处理。
howto.when: 当用户要求使用 Atomic Chat 或本地模型(例如说“用 atomic chat …”)时触发。

say.text: 用 atomic chat 告诉我法国的首都
say.note: Claude 会先列出模型,再选一个生成回答。

say.text: 列出 Atomic Chat 里有哪些可用的模型

howto.what_en: After install, Claude gets two new tools: list models currently loaded in the Atomic Chat desktop app, and send a prompt to a specified model to get a response. Claude stays the orchestrator but can offload some tasks to local models served by Atomic Chat.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to use Atomic Chat or a local model (e.g., saying "use atomic chat ...").

say_en.text: Use atomic chat to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: Claude lists models first, then picks one to answer.

say_en.text: List the models available in Atomic Chat
Use llama3.2-3b-instruct in atomic chat to explain recursion
